class.name: RigKernel
class.brief_description: The per-step state reading and drive-target writing of a learned controller for a physics rig.
class.description: Does, in native code, the work a learned controller repeats every control step on a ragdoll of rigid bodies joined by 6DOF joints with angular drives: reads every body's transform and velocities from the [PhysicsServer3D] once ([method update]), builds the policy's observation ([method observation]) and a motion prior's features ([method features]) from that state, casts rays for the ground under the body ([method ground]), reports foot contacts ([method contact]), and writes an action to the joints' drive targets ([method write_targets]). Configure it once with [method set_bodies], [method set_pelvis_head], one [method add_drive] per actuated joint in action order (which also defines the observed joints), [method set_contacts], [method set_keypoints], [method set_scan] and [method set_ground_mask]. Rotations are expressed as rotation vectors (axis times angle) of a child body relative to its parent, and the heading frame is the pelvis's yaw about world up with +Z forward. For a training server's reward, it also computes terms over the same state: contacts read once a step ([method set_sensed]), the ankles' excess torque ([method ankle_excess]), a knee down ([method knee_down]), a sole over a prop's edge ([method on_edge]), undergrowth's drag on the legs ([method leg_drag]) and the legs' angular speed ([method angular_speed_squared]), reading the terrain's function ([TerrainField], [method set_terrain]) and its [GroundData].

method.name: add_drive
method.description: Adds an actuated joint: the 6DOF [param joint] whose child is [param body]. Each of its [param axes] (0, 1, 2 for x, y, z) takes one action value [code]a[/code], and the drive target's rotation vector is [code]nominal + scale * clamp(a, -1, 1)[/code] on those axes, clamped per component to [param lo] and [param hi]. The observation and features report the joint's rotation on the same axes.

method.name: angular_speed_squared
method.description: The sum of the squared angular speeds of [param bodies] at [method update].

method.name: ankle_excess
method.description: The ankles' pitch torque past people's peak, each as a share of the rest of its cap, summed: from each foot's drive target (its nominal pitch plus the action's value, clamped to [code][-1, 1][/code], times the scale), its angle and rate relative to the lower leg, the drive's stiffness and damping, clamped to the cap. With [param push_only], only an ankle doing positive work counts. Needs [method set_ankles].

method.name: balance
method.description: Returns nine balance quantities from the state [method update] read, every body a point mass at its origin: the capture point (the center of mass's horizontal position plus its horizontal velocity over [code]sqrt(g / h)[/code], [code]h[/code] its height over the ground under it) against the center of the [param support] bodies touching the world (all of them when none does; only sensed bodies count as touching), x and z in the heading frame; [code]h[/code]; the center of mass's velocity in the heading frame; and the bodies' angular momentum about the center of mass over the total mass times [param height] squared, in the heading frame. Gravity is the reward configuration's.

method.name: clear_leg_drag
method.description: Sets no constant force on the leg bodies (see [method leg_drag]).

method.name: contact
method.description: Returns whether any of the left ([param side] 0) or right (1) contact bodies touches something that is not one of the rig's bodies. The bodies need contact reporting enabled.

method.name: contact_friction
method.description: The friction of the collider outside the rig touched by the first of [param bodies] that touches one, or NaN when none does. Sensed bodies are read at [method update] (see [method set_sensed]), others now.

method.name: features
method.description: Returns motion-prior features of the state read by [method update]: the pelvis's height over [param ground_y]; its y and z axes in the heading frame; its linear and angular velocity in the heading frame by finite difference from [param pelvis_prev] at [param fps]; the driven joints' rotations on their axes; and the keypoints relative to the pelvis in the heading frame.

method.name: get_action_size
method.description: Returns the number of action values, the total of the drives' axes.

method.name: get_along
method.description: The distance made along the commanded velocity this episode ([method reward_step]).

method.name: get_amp_pair
method.description: The last [method reward_step]'s motion-prior transition: the features before and after, the command, the style's code and the history.

method.name: get_angular_velocity
method.description: Returns the angular velocity of body [param body] read by [method update].

method.name: get_asked
method.description: The distance the commands asked for this episode ([method reward_step]).

method.name: get_assist_level
method.description: Returns the assist level set by [method set_assist_level].

method.name: get_center_of_mass
method.description: Returns the rig's center of mass read by [method update].

method.name: get_center_of_mass_velocity
method.description: Returns the velocity of the rig's center of mass read by [method update].

method.name: get_edges
method.description: The steps this episode with a foot over a prop's edge ([method reward_step]).

method.name: get_effort_weight
method.description: Returns the effort weight set by [method set_effort_weight].

method.name: get_ground_data
method.description: Returns the ground data set by [method set_ground_data].

method.name: get_ground_mu
method.description: The friction of what a foot last touched ([method observation_full]).

method.name: get_heading
method.description: Returns the heading frame read by [method update]: the pelvis's yaw about world up, +Z forward.

method.name: get_linear_velocity
method.description: Returns the linear velocity of body [param body] read by [method update].

method.name: get_path
method.description: The distance walked this episode, the centre of mass's horizontal speed integrated ([method reward_step]).

method.name: get_scan_size
method.description: Returns the number of the height scan's points.

method.name: get_strengths
method.description: Returns the legs' (with the trunk and the neck) and the arms' strength, as set by [method set_strengths] or [method set_strength].

method.name: get_terrain
method.description: The terrain's function the reward's terms read (see [method set_terrain]).

method.name: get_transform
method.description: Returns the transform of body [param body] read by [method update].

method.name: get_water_data
method.description: Returns the water inputs' data.

method.name: get_water_size
method.description: Returns the number of water inputs (the points' and 3), or 0.

method.name: get_wy_mean
method.description: The pelvis's yaw rate, averaged over a quarter second ([method reward_step]).

method.name: ground
method.description: Returns the height of the first surface on the ground mask below [param point] (a ray from 1 m above it to 4 m below), or 1 m below the point if there is none.

method.name: heading_of
method.description: Returns the yaw of [param basis] about world up as a basis whose +Z is the basis's +Z projected on the horizontal plane.

method.name: knee_down
method.description: Whether a knee is down: a knee joint (see [method set_knees]) less than [param height] over the ground under it ([method ground]), where the terrain's slope there is at most [param max_degrees] (any slope without a terrain).

method.name: leg_drag
method.description: Undergrowth's drag: each leg body (see [method set_legs]) under [param height] over the terrain's ground (every one without a terrain) gets a constant force of [param coefficient] times its horizontal velocity, the others none. Reads the physics server's state now, not [method update]'s.

method.name: observation
method.description: Returns the policy's observation of the state read by [method update]: gravity and the pelvis's angular velocity in the pelvis frame; the center of mass's velocity in the heading frame and its height over the ground; the driven joints' rotations, then their angular velocities relative to their parents (times 0.1); [param action]; [param command]; the left and right contacts; and, if [param scan], the ground's height at the scan points in the heading frame relative to the ground under the center of mass.

method.name: observation_full
method.description: The whole observation of a training step: [method observation] (with the scan when configured), the nearest trunks, the senses (each hand's contact, the friction of what a foot last touched), the [param style]'s code and log [param strength]. Needs [method set_reward_config].

method.name: on_edge
method.description: Whether the foot [param foot] with its toes [param toes] stands over a prop's edge: [method sole_on_edge] with their transforms at [method update].

method.name: reset_terms
method.description: Resets the episode's state for [method reward_step]: the yaw rate's mean, the air times, the counts and distances, the ground's friction, the motion prior's last [param features] (and their history), the pelvis's last transform and the ground under it.

method.name: reward_step
method.description: A training step after the physics, as ProjectEX's [code]amp_env.gd[/code] computes it but for what draws random numbers or changes the command: [method update], the motion prior's transition ([method get_amp_pair]), the task reward (tracking, air time, the ankles, the lean, the split stance, the hands' support, edges, standing still, the action's change; zero off balance), off balance, down (a fall), the water's depth, out of bounds, the blocker distance, the style gate, then 15 values of info. Updates the episode's state (see [method reset_terms]). Needs [method set_reward_config].

method.name: rotation_vector
method.description: Returns the rotation of [param basis] as a rotation vector (axis times angle, the angle in [code][0, PI][/code]).

method.name: set_ankles
method.description: Sets the ankles for [method ankle_excess]: [param bodies] the left lower leg and foot, then the right's; [param actions] each foot's pitch in the action; [param gains] the drive's stiffness, damping and torque cap, the nominal pitch, the action's scale on it, and people's peak ankle torque.

method.name: set_assist_level
method.description: Sets the episode's assist level (the caller applies the push). With the reward configuration's [code]assist_dim[/code] 1, [method observation_full] ends with it.

method.name: set_bodies
method.description: Sets the rig's rigid bodies, their masses, and each one's parent index ([code]-1[/code] for the root). Body indices in the other methods refer to this order.

method.name: set_brace
method.description: Sets the brace's level (0, 0.5 or 1) and whether its button is held (the caller runs the brace). With the reward configuration's [code]brace_dim[/code] 2, [method observation_full] ends with both, after the assist's level.

method.name: set_contacts
method.description: Sets the bodies whose contacts make the left and right contact of [method contact].

method.name: set_drive_groups
method.description: Sets each drive's limb group, in [method add_drive]'s order: 0 the legs, the trunk and the neck, 1 the arms. [method effort] scales each drive's torque cap by its group's strength ([method set_strengths]).

method.name: set_effort_weight
method.description: Sets the episode's effort weight: [method reward_step] subtracts it times [method effort] over the reward configuration's [code]effort_ref[/code] each step, and with the configuration's [code]effort_dim[/code] 1 [method observation_full] ends with it.

method.name: set_field_body
method.description: Sets the terrain's height field body: a sensed body touching it reads the friction of the cell under the contact from the ground data ([method GroundData.friction_at], friction patches) in place of the body's friction, when the ground data has frictions.

method.name: set_ground_data
method.description: Reads the ground from [param data] in place of every ray while it is set and enabled.

method.name: set_ground_mask
method.description: Sets the collision mask of [method ground]'s rays.

method.name: set_keypoints
method.description: Sets the points [method features] reports relative to the pelvis: each an offset in a body's frame.

method.name: set_knees
method.description: Sets the knees for [method knee_down]: each lower leg body and its knee joint's point in that body's frame.

method.name: set_legs
method.description: Sets the leg bodies [method leg_drag] acts on.

method.name: set_pelvis_head
method.description: Sets which bodies are the pelvis (the heading frame's and the observation's reference) and the head.

method.name: set_reward_config
method.description: Configures [method reward_step] and [method observation_full]: the reward's flags, its constants and the bodies it reads, by name (ProjectEX's [code]amp_env.gd[/code] [code]_bind_terms[/code] gives them all).

method.name: set_scan
method.description: Sets the height scan's grid in the heading frame: lateral offsets [param x] and forward offsets [param z]; the observation lists it row by row of [param z].

method.name: set_scan_height
method.description: Sets how far above the pelvis the height scan's rays start (default 1.0). A ray starting inside a body does not hit it, so a wall taller than this reads as the ground at its foot; set it above the tallest wall the scan should see.

method.name: set_scan_points
method.description: Sets the height scan's points (x across, y ahead in the heading frame) in place of [method set_scan]'s grid.

method.name: set_sensed
method.description: Sets the bodies whose contacts [method update] reads (their contact reporting must be on): whether each touches anything outside the rig and that collider's friction, for [method contact], [method touches], [method touches_any] and [method contact_friction].

method.name: set_slip_surface
method.description: With [param enabled], [method slip] and the reward's slip measure a touching body's speed along the ground's surface (the terrain's normal from its fall line) instead of its horizontal speed. The reward configuration's [code]slip_surface[/code] sets it too.

method.name: set_soles
method.description: Sets a sole for [method sole_on_edge]: the heel's corners in the foot's frame, the toe's in the toes', how far over a corner its probe starts ([param lift]), the probe's length, and how far over the terrain's ground a surface must be to count as a prop ([param edge_on]).

method.name: set_static_ground
method.description: When enabled (default off), the ground probes consider static bodies only and the height scan's rays go to the physics server in one batch (Godot-EX's [code]JoltPhysicsServer3D.space_cast_static_ground[/code]; with another physics server, the general ray). Faster where the ground is all static, as on a training server; in a game a dynamic body can be ground.

method.name: set_strengths
method.description: Sets the legs' (with the trunk and the neck) and the arms' strength (one value sets both). The single strength ([method get_strength]) becomes the legs'. With the reward configuration's [code]strength_dim[/code] 2, [method observation_full] ends with both logarithms.

method.name: set_terrain
method.description: Sets the training terrain's function the reward's terms read ([method knee_down], [method sole_on_edge], [method leg_drag]).

method.name: set_water
method.description: Appends the water inputs to a scanned observation: the water's depth over the scan's ground at the scan points [param points] (0 where dry), its depth at the center of mass and its flow there in the heading frame (x, z), from [param data]'s water field (zeros without one).

method.name: sole_on_edge
method.description: Whether a foot at [param foot] with its toes at [param toes] stands over a prop's edge: some of its sole's corners over a prop (the ground data's first surface down from over the corner more than [code]edge_on[/code] over the terrain's ground) and some not. Needs the ground data and [method set_soles].

method.name: touches
method.description: Whether [param body] touches anything outside the rig: at [method update] if sensed (see [method set_sensed]), else now.

method.name: touches_any
method.description: Whether any of [param bodies] touches anything outside the rig (see [method touches]).

method.name: update
method.description: Reads every body's transform and velocities from the physics server, and computes the center of mass and heading frame. Call it once per control step, after the physics steps, before the queries.

method.name: write_targets
method.description: Writes [param action] to the drives' target rotations (see [method add_drive]).
